Field.Name: Message sequence number
Field.Description: A message sequence number given by Market data team - Market data: seq number is given by instruments and boards (※ only for high-bandwidth service) - Batch Data: seq number is given by Information Ca.

Field.Name: Board ID
Field.Description: The Board ID refers to each Board in which an issue is traded under different trading schedules and rules. Individual issue can be traded on more than two Boards under each Board's schedule and with d.

Field.Name: Session ID
Field.Description: A Session is a subordinate concept of a Board and each session follows different trading methods and rules.

Field.Name: ISIN Code
Field.Description: ISIN Code.

Field.Name: A designated number for an issue

Field.Name: Processing Time of Trading System
Field.Description: HHMMSSuuuuuu.

Field.Name: Trading Price
Field.Description: The price at which a security is currently selling in the market.

Field.Name: Trading volume
Field.Description: Trading volume.

Field.Name: Nearby Month Contract_Trading Price
Field.Description: A trading price of nearby month (a component of a futures spread).

Field.Name: Distant Month Contract_Trading Price
Field.Description: A trading price of distant month (a component of a futures spread).

Field.Name: Opening Price
Field.Description: The first price that a security traded upon the opening of the regular session.

Field.Name: Today's High
Field.Description: The highest price at which an instrument traded during the course of the trading day. Also, the record high of a year refers to the highest price of a year.

Field.Name: Today's Low
Field.Description: The lowest price or index at which an issue traded during the course of a day, week, month or year.

Field.Name: Previous price
Field.Description: A trading price made right before the final trading price as of now but with a differenct value. E.g.) 10 am: 90 KRW, 10:10 a.m: 100 KRW, 10:20 a.m (now): 100 -> the previous price is 90 KRW.

Field.Name: Accumulated Trading Volume
Field.Description: Accumulated Trading Volume.

Field.Name: Accumulated Trading value
Field.Description: Accumulated trading value Trading value=trading amount*trading price.

Field.Description: Ask/Bid Type Code space: order filled with single price 0: N/A 1: ASK 2: BID.

Field.Description: Upper Limit of Dynamic Price Range.

Field.Name: Lower Limit of Dynamic Price Range
Field.Description: Lower Limit of Dynamic Price Range.

Field.Description: End of text sentinel (0xFF).
